request.tone: cozy after-hours museum mystery with puzzles; violence none, scariness mild, peril moderate
request.note: catalog book; plan extracted blind by reading the book, no request exists

pitch.hero: Nadia, a label-reading girl in class 6B, locked alone overnight in the old Ellery Museum
pitch.want: to follow a torn map and the founder's recorded tour to his hidden collection
pitch.obstacle: locked doors, a dark museum, a coded note, the founder's puzzles and a roaming night guard
pitch.stake: the town's hidden treasures and the founder's good name, or being caught and walked out
pitch.ending_kind: she finds the vault and chooses what to do with it, or a gentle setback that shows what she missed

nadia.name: Nadia
nadia.want: to find the founder's hidden collection before morning
nadia.voice: close third past; curious, dry, talks back to the handset and to objects

ellery.name: Ambrose Ellery
ellery.role: the long-dead founder, heard on his recorded audio tour; puzzle-setter
ellery.want: for a finder to return the town's treasures and clear his name
ellery.voice: crackling, dry, wry aphorisms about his own museum

pym.name: Mr. Pym
pym.role: the elderly night guard; owner of the half map
pym.want: to find what the founder's mark opens after thirty-one years
pym.voice: kind, firm, dry humor, likes crosswords and tea

tess.name: Tess
tess.role: Nadia's best friend, offstage until late
tess.want: to be let in on the secret

curator.name: the curator
curator.role: museum curator who arrives at eight
curator.want: the truth about the museum, once convinced

mum.name: Nadia's mum
mum.voice: heard only as questions and car keys

truth.question: What is the founder's hidden collection, and why did he hide it?
truth.statement: Ambrose Ellery, the founder, was no thief. With the museum in debt and creditors wanting the town's treasures sold by the pound, he hid them in a secret room under the rotunda's brass globe, let the town call him a thief, and left a trail for a finder: a key under the mark, a coded note, and the globe's combination four, nine, two. His bricked-up east wing still stands inside the walls. The night guard Pym, who hunted the secret for thirty-one years, put his half of the map in handset thirteen.

nadia_reads_labels.text: Nadia is the sort of girl who reads every label in a museum.

left_behind_shoelace.text: Nadia bent to retie her shoe by the last case and her class and the guard left without her.

ellery_museum.text: The museum is the old Ellery Museum, with thick stone walls.

doors_locked.text: The museum's main doors are locked for the night.

no_phone_signal.text: Nadia's phone has no signal behind the museum's stone walls.

mum_thinks_tess.text: Nadia's mum thinks Nadia is sleeping over at Tess's.

tess_thinks_home_sick.text: Tess thinks Nadia went home sick.

nobody_misses_her.text: Nobody will miss Nadia before morning.

handset_thirteen.text: Nadia wears audio guide handset thirteen around her neck, the one nobody else wanted.

half_map_in_pouch.text: Half of an old museum map, torn down the middle, was tucked in the handset pouch.

mark_circle_two_lines.text: The map carries a small brass mark, a circle crossed by two lines.

map_ringed_wing.text: The map has a pencil ring around a wing Nadia has never seen on any plan of the museum.

map_note_hidden_collection.text: Beside the ring the map says in square pencil letters: the founder's hidden collection, start at the mark.

night_lights_out.text: The lobby lights are switching off row by row for the night setting.

green_lamp_lobby.text: The last lamp in the lobby is a green one over the visitors' book.

tour_board_chalk.text: The lobby tour board reads TODAY'S TOURS in yellow chalk, with a stub of chalk on its ledge.

night_guard_on_rounds.text: A night guard walks rounds in the museum and passes the tour board.

read_map_back.text: Nadia read the back of her half of the map under the lobby lamp.

back_brown_ink.text: The back of Nadia's half carries half a sentence in brown ink: the east wing is not gone, it has one door left, and that door opens only, cut off by the tear.

rope_gallery_warning.text: A square pencil warning on the map back says the rope gallery door shuts itself, so wedge it, and its writer sat in there till the cleaners came.

map_first_turned_in_gallery.text: Nadia had not turned the map over before she was shut in the roped gallery.

chalk_message.text: Nadia chalked LOCKED IN, NOT A BURGLAR, NADIA FROM CLASS 6B, BACK SOON on the tour board.

chalk_in_pocket.text: Nadia kept the stub of chalk in her coat pocket.

lobby_lamp_off.text: The last lobby lamp clicked off and Nadia followed the moonlight toward the middle of the museum.

rotunda_globe.text: The rotunda holds a huge brass globe of rings inside rings on a stone pedestal.

globe_stop_one.text: The brass globe is stop one on the audio tour.

plaques_key_tour.text: Exhibits carry numbered plaques; keying a number into the handset plays that stop.

ambrose_ellery_founder.text: The museum's founder is old Ambrose Ellery.

ellery_recorded_tour.text: Ellery recorded his own audio tour almost a hundred years ago.

globe_is_heart.text: Ellery calls the brass globe the heart of his museum.

ellery_four_seconds.text: Ellery's recording says most people look at the globe for four seconds.

three_archways.text: Three archways lead from the rotunda: the Gallery of Gems, the Egyptian Wing, and the stairs down to the Archive.

gems_gallery_stop_12.text: The Gallery of Gems is stop twelve, where Ellery says he never cared for diamonds but needed people.

gems_case_crooked.text: A big glass case of gems sits crooked on its stand in the Gallery of Gems.

beeping_in_gallery.text: A soft, steady beeping comes from somewhere in the Gallery of Gems.

gems_case_opened_hurry.text: Someone opened the crooked gem case in a hurry not long ago, leaving a smear and the door unlatched.

someone_searched_before.text: Somebody else has been searching the museum before Nadia.

tilted_vitrine.text: A small vitrine in the gem case sits tilted, as if something is wedged under it.

fallen_card.text: A little card has fallen face down behind the vitrine.

nadia_has_token.text: Nadia carries a brass token the size of a coin, stamped with the map's mark.

token_inscription.text: The brass token reads LEAVE ME WHERE YOU TAKE around its other side.

no_coin_token.text: Nadia has nothing coin-shaped to leave in the owl's place.

gems_back_door.text: A narrow door stands half hidden behind a folded screen in the back wall of the Gallery of Gems.

founder_thin_hand.text: The founder wrote in a thin hand.

founder_glass_ring_label.text: An old label in the founder's hand says the ring is glass, the real one and much else went somewhere safer, and the curious should try the corridor.

founder_moved_treasures.text: The founder moved real treasures out of the displays to somewhere safer.

gems_corridor_on_map.text: Nadia's half of the map shows a narrow corridor behind the Gallery of Gems.

corridor_skirting_mark.text: At the end of the corridor behind the gems, the map's mark is scratched on a loose skirting board.

beeping_is_sensor.text: The beeping is a wall sensor with a tired battery.

guard_torch_humming.text: The night guard checks the cases with a torch, humming to himself.

guard_ends_night.text: If the guard finds Nadia he will walk her to the lobby and the map will go in a drawer.

marble_busts.text: A row of white marble busts, each wearing a necklace, stands in the Gallery of Gems.

guard_31_years.text: The night guard has worked in the museum for thirty-one years.

guard_seeks_secret.text: The night guard has long been seeking some secret of the museum.

egypt_stop_19.text: The Egyptian Wing is stop nineteen, where Ellery calls the lady in the painted box the best listener in the building.

sarcophagus_lid_crooked.text: The painted sarcophagus in the Egyptian Wing has its lid sitting crooked.

old_wall_map.text: A faded wall map in the Egyptian Wing shows the museum a hundred years ago, with halls Nadia has never walked.

amulet_dent_empty.text: One coin-sized dent in the amulet case's velvet sits empty.

draught_behind_sarcophagus.text: A cool draught comes from a gap in the wall behind the sarcophagus, leading to a hall.

amulet_card_founder_took.text: The amulet card says the token of the house was removed by the founder and is not far away.

hall_tile_mark.text: In the bare hall behind the Egyptian Wing, a loose floor tile carries the map's mark.

ringed_wing_behind_egypt.text: The ringed wing on Nadia's map matches the old wall map and begins right behind the Egyptian room.

torch_on_bracket.text: A power-cut torch hangs on a bracket by the wall map.

roped_gallery.text: A red rope marked CLOSED FOR REPAIR bars the door of a dark gallery, with cold air coming from under it.

torch_died.text: The power-cut torch died on the way to the bare hall.

bricked_arch_29.text: The roped gallery holds a huge bricked-up arch with the number 29 painted on it.

east_wing_behind_arch.text: Ellery's stop 29 says his east wing, the best rooms in the house, lies through the bricked arch.

gallery_no_inside_handle.text: The roped gallery door shuts itself and has no handle on the inside.

archive_stop_31.text: The Archive is stop thirty-one, the museum's memory that forgets only where it put things.

visitor_ledger.text: A visitor ledger lies open on a stand in the Archive.

back_stacks_dark.text: The Archive's back stacks run off into the dark.

founder_came_to_hide.text: On the ledger's first page the founder signed and wrote that he came to hide something.

card_index_drawer.text: A card index stands by the ledger, over a cabinet whose stuck bottom drawer clinks.

row_q_card.text: A card stamped with the mark says the founder filed something under Q, at the far end of the back stacks behind the dictionaries.

shelf_letters.text: White letters painted on the shelf ends mark the Archive's rows.

stacks_plan_row_q.text: A folded plan of the stacks rings one shelf in Row Q.

row_q_mark_dictionaries.text: In Row Q, the last row, the mark is cut into a shelf edge behind a row of old dictionaries with a gap behind them.

lantern_on_hook.text: An old battery lantern hangs on a hook at the edge of the back stacks.

grating_to_lobby.text: A grating over the back stacks opens on the lobby floor, so a light below would show to the guard.

founder_tour_records.text: Gramophone records labeled The Founder's Tour, 1 to 36, are shelved in the stacks.

records_for_finder.text: Four boxes of records marked 37 to 40 and labeled For the finder sit apart in the stacks.

tour_has_36_stops.text: The museum's audio tour officially ends at stop thirty-six.

brass_key_found.text: Nadia found a small brass key with the map's mark on its head, wrapped in oilcloth.

coded_note.text: A note in code, rows of letters that spell nothing, is tied to the brass key.

tag_37.text: A brass tag stamped 37 came with the key, and keying it plays a hidden stop.

key_three_locks.text: Ellery says the key fits three locks to his rooms at the top of the house: his study, his glass cabinet, and his back stair, each hiding a way to read the note.

founder_study.text: The founder's study is thick with dust and has a roll-top desk.

founder_portrait.text: A portrait of the founder shows a white beard, a sharp nose and dark eyes.

portrait_hinged.text: The founder's portrait hangs away from the wall on a hinge, hiding a shallow safe.

reading_table_landing.text: A small reading table stands by the landing window outside the founder's rooms.

notebook_worked_line.text: A slim notebook in the desk shows one line of the code with its plain meaning penciled beneath.

nadia_has_glasses.text: Nadia keeps a pair of round reading glasses that make tiny writing readable, pushed up in her hair.

cipher_wheel.text: A brass wheel with two rings of letters, for turning one alphabet into another, sat in the safe.

glass_cabinet_journals.text: A glass cabinet on the landing holds the founder's travel journals, its hinge glued by old varnish.

guard_on_stairs.text: The guard is coming up the main stairs, humming, with jingling keys.

ribboned_ledger.text: A slim ledger with a ribbon marking one page lies among the travel journals.

cipher_shift_three.text: The code shifts every letter three places along the alphabet.

cabinet_creak_alerts_guard.text: Forcing the cabinet lid made the glass creak and the guard called out.

green_lamp_table.text: The reading table has a green-shaded lamp on a brass chain.

bulb_changed.text: The reading table lamp still lights, so someone has been changing its bulb.

back_stair_cupboard.text: A small cupboard stands open a crack at the foot of the back stair.

study_back_way.text: The back stair leads up to the landing and the study door.

brass_dial_wall.text: A brass dial with two rings of letters is set in the wall at the head of the back stair.

rolled_ring_chart.text: A brittle rolled chart in the cupboard shows two rings of letters with a tiny line of instructions.

note_follow_stars.text: The decoded note says: follow the stars to the heart of my house.

heart_means_globe.text: The heart of the house is the brass globe in the rotunda.

three_roads.text: The globe sleeps until one of three roads wakes it: the Astronomy Hall, the Map Room, or the Clock Corridor.

combo_492.text: The globe's rings must be set to four, nine, and two.

astronomy_stop_22.text: The Astronomy Hall is stop twenty-two, under a painted dome of gold stars.

one_star_liar.text: Ellery says one of the painted stars is a liar.

spiral_stair_and_ladder.text: A spiral stair climbs the dome wall and a STAFF ONLY ladder hides behind a curtain.

liar_star_stud.text: The liar star is a brass stud that opens a hidden door when pressed.

caged_walkway.text: The staff ladder ends at a caged walkway under the dome, with a second ladder going on into the dark.

map_room_stop_25.text: The Map Room is stop twenty-five, where Ellery says his maps keep their promises.

sky_globe.text: A great floor globe of the night sky turns on brass rails in the Map Room.

giant_atlas.text: A giant atlas lies open on a slanted stand in the Map Room.

gold_star_mechanism.text: Bringing a gold star to its mark works a hidden catch that opens a passage.

atlas_museum_chart.text: A hand-drawn chart in the atlas shows the museum as a constellation with a red route to a large star in the middle, and says mind the crates.

clock_stop_27.text: The Clock Corridor is stop twenty-seven, full of clocks Ellery built.

gear_room_and_pendulum.text: The Clock Corridor has a gear room at one end and a great pendulum swinging across a doorway at the other.

pendulum_hangs_clear.text: The pendulum hangs clear of the doorway on its far swing, and a gold star is painted on the floor beyond.

globe_awake.text: A wire pulled a brass pin from the globe and its rings shivered free; the heart of the house is awake.

rings_and_tiles.text: The globe has three rings numbered like a clock, above a pedestal carved with small square tiles.

night_guard_room.text: A door marked NIGHT GUARD stands ajar off the rotunda, with a gray light flickering inside.

rings_worn_slippery.text: The ring numbers are worn so a four looks like a nine, and the rings slide past the mark easily.

hidden_stair.text: A marble slab beside the globe's pedestal slides back to show a narrow stair down.

third_ring_caught.text: A wrong guess left the third ring caught a finger's width short of the two.

pedestal_tiles_slide.text: The pedestal's carved tiles slide like a puzzle.

low_door_rotunda.text: A low door painted white hides in the curve of the rotunda wall, breathing a cold draught.

tiles_make_mark.text: Solved, the pedestal tiles show the map's mark as wide as a hand.

workshop_room.text: Behind the low door is a hidden room of workbenches and half-built brass things, with 39 chalked on the frame.

workshop_39.text: Ellery's stop thirty-nine says the hidden workshop is where he hid from his own museum.

brass_wren.text: A brass wren no bigger than a thumb, with a key in its back, sits on the workshop bench.

guard_room_screens.text: The night guard's room has old screens, a warm chair, a rounds book, cold tea, a crossword and a black phone.

crossword_has_nadia.text: The guard's crossword has NADIA printed on it.

clockwork_quarter_to_four.text: At a quarter to four, if the heart is awake, the founder's clockwork brings the rings home by itself and opens the floor.

guards_never_saw_it.text: Generations of guards signed the founder's rule and the last wrote in square pencil that he never saw it happen.

pym_saw_board.text: The night guard saw Nadia's chalk message and has searched every room twice for her.

front_doors_unlocked.text: The guard has unlocked the front doors and waits at the front desk with the kettle on.

guard_named_pym.text: The night guard is named Pym.

map_is_pyms.text: The pencil writing on Nadia's map is the night guard's; it is his map.

pym_placed_map.text: Pym put the map in handset thirteen himself a month ago after carrying it for thirty-one years.

pym_hunted_key.text: Pym has hunted for the founder's brass key for thirty-one years.

phone_dial_tone.text: The guard's black phone has a working dial tone.

vault_38.text: Under the rotunda is a stone room, stop thirty-eight, full of paintings, carvings and small treasures under a century of dust.

treasures_belong_to_town.text: Every piece in the hidden room belongs to the town; Ellery hid it from men who meant to sell it by the pound.

sealed_letter.text: A sealed letter marked To the finder leans on a shelf in the hidden room.

other_map_half.text: The other torn half of the old map lies in the hidden room.

jewelled_owl.text: A small jewelled owl sits on a shelf in the hidden room.

letter_opened.text: Nadia herself broke the seal and read the founder's letter in the hidden room.

letter_still_sealed.text: Nadia left the hidden room with the founder's letter still sealed.

letter_opened_with_curator.text: The curator and the town hall opened and read the founder's letter together.

town_thinks_ellery_thief.text: The town was told Ellery sold its treasures and kept the money.

museum_in_debt.text: The museum owed more than it owned, and its creditors wanted everything sold.

ellery_hid_took_blame.text: Ellery hid the treasures, took the blame, and waited for the debts to die, but they outlived him.

stop_40_truth.text: The letter says keying in forty will show where the whole truth is kept.

letter_tiny_line.text: One more line under the founder's name is written too small to read.

letter_ps_bulb_keeper.text: The tiny line says whoever kept the reading lamp's bulb changed has earned a look at the room.

nadia_deduces_guard.text: Nadia works out that the bulb changer must be the night guard.

ledger_of_pieces.text: A leather book behind a panel lists every piece in the room and where in the town it belongs.

ellery_not_thief.text: Ellery was not a thief; he saved the town's treasures.

nadia_keeps_letter.text: Nadia keeps the letter and leaves the room untouched until she has a plan.

east_wing_intact.text: The whole map shows the lost east wing bricked up but never pulled down, still inside the walls.

dotted_line_shelf.text: A dotted line on the whole map runs from the hidden room through the back of the last shelf to the lost wing.

lost_wing_paintings.text: The lost wing is a long gallery of paintings the town was told were sold and lost.

wing_photographed.text: Nadia photographed every frame she could reach in the lost wing.

map_photographed.text: Nadia photographed the whole map, the shelves and the letter, and left everything in place.

founders_door_garden.text: The rest of the brown ink says the east wing's one door opens only from within onto the garden, and the brass key fits it.

lost_wing_garden_windows.text: The lost wing has nine windows down the garden side, the last one dusty and dark.

curator_at_eight.text: The curator unlocks the staff door at eight.

tess_no_secrets.text: Tess has never been told a secret second.

guard_room_pad.text: The guard's room has a pad of paper and a pencil on a string.

owl_hollow.text: Lifting the owl reveals a coin-sized hollow stamped with the mark, and a spring under the shelf begins to wind.

shelf_bells.text: Taking the owl without leaving anything sets off a row of bells that cannot be stopped.

shelf_counts.text: The owl's shelf counts what is taken from it.

owl_speaks.text: Wound up, the owl says in Ellery's voice that it is his owl and whoever carries it should be believed.

nadia_found_nothing.text: Nadia had not found what the mark opens when the guard caught her.

cleaners_at_six.text: The cleaners come at six in the morning.

key_lost_grating.text: The brass key flew from Nadia's hand and fell through a grating under the pendulum.

pendulum_count_three.text: The pendulum's underside says: count to three, and walk.

dome_stars_mark.text: Seen from the top of the dome, the gold stars form the map's mark.

town_restored_plate.text: The pieces went back to the town and a brass plate reading NOT A THIEF was hung under Ellery's portrait.

wing_opened_to_town.text: The lost wing was opened to the town and a new plaque stop was added.

curator_says_no_room.text: The curator believes there is no room under the rotunda.

secret_kept_with_tess.text: Nadia and Tess keep the hidden room secret together until the end of term.

found_by_visitor_plaque.text: The museum credits the find to a curious visitor who left no name.

key_on_guard_desk.text: The brass key lies on the guard's desk.

n_open.event: Nadia is locked in the Ellery Museum overnight with handset thirteen and half a torn map ringing the founder's hidden collection.

n_desk.event: The lobby lights die row by row; she can read the map under the last lamp or chalk a message on the tour board.

n_desk_map.event: Under the green lamp she reads the map's back: half a brown-ink sentence about the east wing and a pencil warning to wedge the rope gallery door.

n_desk_chalk.event: She chalks NOT A BURGLAR on the tour board and pockets the chalk.

n_start.event: In the rotunda the founder's recorded voice introduces the brass globe, the heart of his museum; three archways lead on.

a_gems1.event: The Gallery of Gems has a crooked gem case and a faint beeping.

a_gems_case.event: The crooked case was opened in a hurry; a vitrine tilts and a card has fallen.

a_gems_vitrine.event: Under the vitrine she finds the brass token, LEAVE ME WHERE YOU TAKE, and an arrow to a narrow door.

a_gems_note.event: The fallen card, in the founder's thin hand, says the real treasures went somewhere safer and points to the corridor.

a_gems_corridor.event: The empty corridor ends at a loose skirting board scratched with the mark.

a_gems_alarm.event: The beeping is a tired sensor; the night guard's torch approaches and she must hide.

a_gems_hide.event: Hidden behind the plinth she hears the guard tell the diamond he has asked it for thirty-one years.

b_egypt1.event: The Egyptian Wing has a crooked sarcophagus lid and an old wall map of the museum.

b_egypt_sarco.event: Someone moved the lid before her; an amulet dent the size of a coin sits empty.

b_egypt_lid.event: Under the lid lies the brass token, LEAVE ME WHERE YOU TAKE; a draught leads to a hall.

b_egypt_amulet.event: The amulet card says the founder took the token of the house; an arrow points to the hall.

b_egypt_hall.event: In a bare hall a loose floor tile carries the mark.

b_egypt_map.event: The wall map shows the ringed wing begins behind this room; a torch hangs nearby and a roped gallery waits.

b_egypt_torch.event: She follows the lost wing by torch until the battery dies near a glint.

b_egypt_wedge.event: Heeding the warning she wedges the door, finds the bricked arch 29 to the east wing, and leaves by a side door.

c_archive1.event: In the Archive a visitor ledger lies open by lamplight and the back stacks run into the dark.

c_archive_ledger.event: The founder signed the ledger's first page: to hide something; a card index and a stuck drawer wait.

c_archive_index.event: A card stamped with the mark sends her to Row Q behind the dictionaries.

c_archive_drawer.event: The drawer gives up the brass token and a plan ringing a shelf in Row Q.

c_archive_stack.event: In Row Q the mark is cut into a shelf edge, with a gap behind the dictionaries.

c_archive_dark.event: At the edge of the dark stacks: a lantern that might show through the grating, or feeling her way.

c_archive_lantern.event: She risks the lantern, nobody comes, and the shelf letters lead to the last row.

c_archive_chalk.event: Chalking arrows through the dark she finds the founder's tour records 1 to 36 and four more for the finder, then Row Q.

n_key.event: Under the mark she finds the brass key, a coded note and tag 37; Ellery's hidden stop says the key opens three locks to his rooms.

k_founder.event: The key opens the dusty study with a roll-top desk and a hinged portrait of the founder.

k_founder_desk.event: In the desk: a notebook with one decoded line and round glasses that make tiny writing readable.

k_founder_portrait.event: Behind the portrait a safe holds a brass cipher wheel.

k_display.event: The key fits the glass cabinet but the lid sticks while the guard climbs the stairs.

k_display_open.event: Working the lid patiently, she outlasts the guard and finds a ribboned ledger.

k_cabinet.event: The ribboned page is a shift-three alphabet table for the note.

k_display_force.event: Shoving the lid makes the glass creak and the guard calls out.

k_display_careful.event: She hides until the guard leaves, opens the lid gently, gets the shift-three table and lights the reading lamp.

k_stairs.event: The key opens the back stair; a cupboard sits ajar at the bottom step.

k_stairs_up.event: At the top a wall dial shows every letter stepped three places on.

k_stairs_base.event: The cupboard holds a ring chart and round glasses that read its tiny line: turn three places.

k_study.event: At the reading table the green lamp lights and she flattens the coded note.

n_cipher.event: Decoded: follow the stars to the heart of the house by one of three roads, and set the rings to four, nine, and two.

ci_stars.event: Under the painted dome Ellery says one star is a liar; a spiral stair and a staff ladder climb.

ci_stars_dome.event: From the stair she finds the liar star, a brass stud that opens a passage.

ci_stars_ladder.event: The ladder ends at a caged walkway; a second ladder climbs into the dark dome.

ci_stars_cross.event: Crossing the walkway she presses the liar star and a door opens on a stair down.

ci_map.event: The Map Room holds a great sky globe and a giant atlas.

ci_map_globe.event: Turning the gold star under the pointer opens a panel to a passage.

ci_map_atlas.event: A hand-drawn chart shows the museum as a constellation with a red route to the middle.

ci_atlas2.event: She follows the red route past the crates to a door marked with a gold star.

ci_clock.event: The Clock Corridor has a gear room at one end and a great pendulum across a doorway at the other.

ci_clock_gears.event: She sets the master clock's hands to its gold star and a door opens.

ci_clock_pendulum.event: The pendulum hangs clear on its far swing; she must time it or rush it.

ci_clock_cross.event: Walking on the beat she passes the pendulum safely.

n_rotunda.event: Back in the rotunda a wire frees the globe's rings; she can set them, search the pedestal, or slip into the guard's room.

ro_align.event: The ring numbers are worn and the rings slide easily.

ro_align_set.event: Checking each number twice she sets four, nine, two and a stair opens beside the pedestal.

ro_align_guess.event: Guessing by ear fails and the third ring catches just short of the two.

ro_align_retry.event: She frees the ring, reads four, nine, two off the note, and the stair opens.

ro_panel.event: The pedestal's tiles slide, and a draught leads to a hidden low door in the wall.

ro_panel_solve.event: She slides the tiles into the mark and the stair opens.

ro_panel_secret.event: The low door opens on a dusty room of half-built brass things, 39 chalked on its frame.

ro_workshop.event: Stop 39: Ellery's hidden workshop, and a brass wren with a key.

ro_records.event: The guard's room is empty: screens, a rounds book, a crossword and a black phone.

ro_records_guard.event: The founder's rule in the rounds book says the clockwork opens the floor at a quarter to four; it is nearly that, and she runs.

ro_records_note.event: The guard, Pym, saw her board, has unlocked the doors and waits with tea; his square letters match her map.

ro_pym.event: At the front desk Pym sees the brass key he has hunted thirty-one years and sends her to ring her mother.

ro_records_phone.event: The guard's phone has a dial tone; home is one call away, the globe waiting behind her.

n_vault.event: Stop 38: the hidden room of the town's treasures, with a sealed letter to the finder, the other map half and a jewelled owl.

v_letter.event: The letter says Ellery hid the treasures from creditors and took the blame; key in forty for the whole truth.

v_letter_ps.event: Through the glasses the tiny line says the bulb changer has earned a look; it must be the night guard.

v_letter_reveal.event: Stop 40 leads her to a leather book listing every piece and where in town it belongs.

v_reveal2.event: Reading the book to the end, the thief the town remembered becomes a man who saved its treasures.

v_letter_keep.event: She keeps the letter, leaves the room untouched, and closes the slab until she has a plan.

v_map.event: The two halves join to show the lost east wing still inside the walls, reached through the last shelf.

v_map_follow.event: Through the shelf she finds the lost wing's gallery of paintings and photographs them.

v_map_photo.event: She photographs the map, shelves and letter and leaves everything in place.

v_map_back.event: The whole map's back completes the brown ink: the east wing's one door opens onto the garden and her key fits it.

v_share.event: Up in the rotunda with the sealed letter she weighs the curator at eight, Tess, or leaving it for the museum.

v_share_curator.event: She waits for the curator and leads her to the open floor with the sealed letter.

v_share_secret.event: She slips out and tells Tess first, swearing her to secrecy.

v_share_museum.event: She leaves both map halves, a note with the combination, the letter and the key on the guard's desk.

v_grab.event: Lifting the owl reveals a coin-sized hollow with the mark, and a spring begins to wind.

v_grab_run.event: She runs with the owl and bells ring; she had nothing coin-shaped to leave.

v_grab_return.event: She sets the owl back, the spring stops, and she lists the room on the back of the coded note.

v_grab_swap.event: She presses the token into the hollow; the owl speaks in Ellery's voice to vouch for its carrier.

e_set_alarm.event: The guard, Pym, spots her among the busts, reveals he put the map in handset thirteen, and rings her mother.

e_set_locked_gallery.event: Shut in the roped gallery, she finally turns the map over and reads the warning to wedge the door.

e_set_stuck_dark.event: Lost in the dark stacks until six, she wakes beside the finder's records ten steps from the mark.

e_set_broken_case.event: She cracks the cabinet glass; the guard finds her and learns the ledger is a code key.

e_set_stuck_dome.event: High in the dome she sees the stars form the mark, and the guard talks her down.

e_set_pendulum.event: The pendulum knocks her down and the key falls through a grating; its underside says count to three and walk.

e_set_jammed_globe.event: Forcing the ring jams the globe; at a quarter to four the clockwork strains and fails to open the stair.

e_set_caught.event: The bells lead the guard to her; he takes the owl down and silences them.

e_set_dawn.event: Tracing every room she runs out of night and sees the lost wing's nine windows from the street.

e_win_secret_workshop.event: The wren sings and bows; she waits for the curator with living proof of the workshop.

e_win_night_guard.event: She and Pym open the stair together and argue over who tells the curator.

e_win_mystery_solved.event: The book reaches the guard, then the curator, and the treasures go home under a plate saying NOT A THIEF.

e_win_quiet_keeper.event: Over weeks she nudges the curator with questions until the curator kneels at the globe.

e_win_lost_wing.event: Her photographs bring the curator and experts, and the lost wing opens to the town.

e_win_founders_door.event: She walks the lost wing, leaves by the founder's garden door with her key, and returns by the front.

e_win_owl_witness.event: The curator doubts her until the owl speaks in Ellery's voice.

e_win_hero_curator.event: The curator goes down, the letter is read aloud, and Ellery is cleared.

e_win_secret_kept.event: Nadia and Tess guard the room together until the end of term.

e_win_donate.event: The museum finds the room on its own and credits a nameless curious visitor; the guard winks.

e_neutral_call_home.event: She calls her mum, and the guard finds her in his chair and asks her to start at the beginning.

e_neutral_evidence.event: She slips out, returns as a visitor, and shows the curator her photographs.

e_neutral_wiser.event: She hands the curator a forty-line list of the room, written on the back of the coded note.

the token fills the owl's hollow, as LEAVE ME WHERE YOU TAKE asked
the glasses read the letter's tiny last line, pointing to the night guard
